text:
Priya: Need a quick sync to lock the May 20 webinar run-of-show. Working title: 'Practical Inference: micro-demos, costs, and safe fallbacks'. Short ask: one-sentence landing copy, demo owners, rehearsal times, and who will handle live chat.

Sasha: I can write the landing sentence + 3 bullets. Will keep it engineering-first.

Kevin: Happy to do the 18m keynote — focusing on routing, batching, and quantization decisions.

Miguel: I'll own routing/fallback demo. Plan: show auto-fallback to q4 variant, plus a quick metric slide.

Tara: I'll take quantization+batching micro-demo and attach the notebook and chart.

Priya: Sasha demo1 (cache warmup), Miguel demo2 (routing/fallback), Tara demo3 (quant+batch). Kevin keynote.

Sasha: Demo harness: single prompt repeated 8x to show cold->warm. Will include a 1-slide table and a static screenshot for backup.

Miguel: Backup plan: recorded 60-90s clip at https://drive.redwood/webinar-backups/routing-60s.mp4 and a static CSV screenshot.

Tara: I'll upload a pre-run chart and a short narration text in case we need to read results.

ops-bot: Tech rehearsal reserved: May 18 10:00-10:45 PDT. Full dress: May 19 09:00-10:00 PDT. Calendar invites sent.

Priya: Run-of-show draft (please edit):
00:00 Intro & agenda (Priya) 3m
03:00 Keynote (Kevin) 18m
21:00 Demo 1: KV cache warmup (Sasha) 5m
26:00 Demo 2: Routing + fallback (Miguel) 5m
31:00 Demo 3: Quantization + batching (Tara) 5m
36:00 Live Q&A (panel) 15m
51:00 Close & CTAs (Priya) 2m

Sasha: Action items: landing sentence + 1-slide demo + prompts. ETA: May 2 EOD.

Kevin: I'll upload slides and a single benchmark slide. ETA: May 3.

Miguel: Routing script + golden metrics + backup video. ETA: May 3.

Tara: Notebook + chart + narration. ETA: May 3.

Priya: Marketing needs: 1-line landing copy, 1-line bios, CTA link, demo repo. Drop into https://drive.redwood/webinar-assets/ by May 4.

Anna: I'll staff chat and help route leads to solutions. Miguel/Tara will handle technical escalations.

Priya: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock schedule after lunch. Thanks! :white_check_mark:

Sasha: SGTM :thumbsup:

Kevin: LGTM.

Miguel: All good.

Tara: Ready.
